note: all physics output is synthetic (random-weight stand-in models)

model_requests_in_flight.what: model requests admitted and sent whose reply is not back (time queued inside a server included)
model_requests_in_flight.source: each call's [t_end - service_s, t_end] (its call record)

autonmi_sampled.source: AUTONMI's summary.json: agent_states_over_time.model_request (Flowgentic's agents in MODEL_REQUEST, sampled at each export, about every 10 s) and agent_seconds_by_state.model_request (its agent-seconds) / agent_phase_s

littles_law.per: per second of the agent phase (agent_phase_s), the calls' rate too; the last figure per second of the whole run (wall_seconds: start-up and shut-down included)

loop_lag.rule: high: the loop's 95th-percentile lag is at least 10% of the mean time in flight, which it lands inside (the count then measures the loop as well as the model)

model_requests_queued.what: model requests waiting for the client's admission caps (llm.max_in_flight, llm.admission_tokens)
model_requests_queued.source: each call's wait_s before its time in flight

agents_live.source: AUTONMI's rows (app/agents-p*.jsonl): each hosted agent's t_start to t_end

speed.decoding_at_servers_why_not: the stub LLM: no model servers

headline.label: client side, emulated (stub LLM, llm.stub_latency_s = 40.0 s per call)
